verifiedAtPolicy: verifiedAt is the date of the last reconciliation that covered EVERY entry, not the freshest evidence in the file. A single-surface re-vet records its own date inside that entry's reason and deliberately does not move this field, so an entry reason may legitimately postdate verifiedAt; reading this field as the latest documented verification overstates what was checked.
historicalEvidencePolicy: Archived receipts, dated plans, prior releases, and old acceptance evidence are immutable history and are not repinned by this ledger.
integrityCoveragePolicy: An entry's integrity hash is assumed to cover the artifact that actually executes. When it does not — the distributed package is a launcher that fetches its real payload at run time — the entry must set integrityCovers to "launcher-only" and its reason must name the unrecorded hop. A launcher-only entry may not be declared egress "none" in src/mcp/servers.ts: provisioning is real egress even when steady-state operation is local.

The recorded integrity is the PyPI wheel's sha256, and that wheel is a launcher shim (__init__.py, __main__.py, _cli.py) rather than the payload. Its _cli.py main() fetches the platform release archive from the upstream GitHub release on first run, unpacks a large native binary into the per-user cache (~296 MB measured at 0.10.4), and exec's it — so this hash does not cover the executed artifact and no recorded pin does; integrityCovers is launcher-only for exactly that reason. The catalog launch's --offline governs uv wheel resolution only and does not reach urllib inside the shim, so provisioning is real egress and the server is declared egress vendor-incumbent (github.com) in src/mcp/servers.ts, not egress none. Moved 0.9.0 -> 0.10.5 on 2026-08-15. The move was taken for supply-chain reasons: 0.10.5's _verify_checksum is fail-closed and exits on any verification failure, where 0.9.0's swallowed every non-SystemExit exception, so an unreachable or malformed checksums.txt no longer lets an unverified archive execute. The exact pinned launch was exercised with the pinned uv 0.12.2 on Linux x86_64 and on Windows amd64: both exit 0 and answer initialize with the pinned serverInfo.version, provisioning reports checksum verified, and the coordination daemon introduced in 0.10.0 does not detach — no process outlives the stdio child on either platform. Linux was verified at 0.10.4, whose launcher shim is byte-identical to 0.10.5's, with the entire release delta inside the fetched native payload. From 0.10.0 the graph UI is always included and its HTTP listener binds 127.0.0.1:9749 by default, loopback only and never a routable address; that inbound surface is named in the catalog description because egress describes outbound traffic and does not cover a listening socket. The 0.10.4 hold is discharged: its daemon refused to create a secure endpoint on Windows hosts whose user-profile AppData carries an AppContainer capability ACE — which the Codex sandbox group grants and actively re-provisions, so clearing it locally was not a durable remedy — and upstream fixed that ancestor check in 0.10.5. The fix was confirmed on the exact host that produced the failure, with the capability ACE still present and the sandbox still running.
